galaxy.summary: "Bakta is a tool for the rapid & standardized annotation of bacterial genomes and plasmids from both isolates and MAGs.It provides dbxref-rich and sORF-including annotations in machine-readable JSON & bioinformatics standard file formats for automatic downstream analysis."
